# Multizer LLC

> New Jersey technology services business founded and operated by Hyun Lee since 2015. Multizer acted as the outsourced IT department for small businesses and residential customers: managed IT, custom software, AI automation tailored to each business, network infrastructure, and physical security (CCTV, access control) from one accountable partner. Operations are currently paused and no new service requests are being accepted.
>
> Multizer is a systems integrator (SI). IT infrastructure and low-voltage projects depend on power and electrical work, so Multizer frequently collaborated with electrical contracting companies and coordinated that work as part of each project. Hyun Lee also gained personal hands-on field experience with electrical drawings and electrical work, which lets him plan and deliver a whole project end to end. Some customer reviews therefore mention electrical work alongside networking, cabling, and security installation. Multizer's own license category is Telecom Contractor (see below).

## Founder

- Hyun Lee, founder and operator of Multizer LLC (New Jersey).
- Previously ran NeoCymax, a technology business in New York.
- Experience: computer troubleshooting, network and Wi-Fi systems, security cameras, video doorbells, telecommunications, reading electrical drawings and personal hands-on electrical field work, electrical project coordination with electrical contractors, custom software and AI automation development, and technical services for residential and business customers.

## What Multizer offered

Three core solution areas, as described on https://multizer.com:

- **Operate: Managed IT Operations.** System administration, backup and disaster recovery, and rapid-response helpdesk, with one accountable technical partner.
- **Build: Digital Solutions.** Custom applications and AI automation built around each customer's workflow, cloud collaboration tools, and technology planning.
- **Secure: Infrastructure and Security.** Cybersecurity monitoring, network and low-voltage cabling, CCTV, and access control.

System integration and electrical coordination: IT infrastructure and low-voltage jobs (network, cabling, cameras, access control) often require power and electrical work. Multizer regularly worked together with electrical contractors and coordinated their scope with the IT and low-voltage installation. Hyun Lee's personal field experience with electrical drawings and electrical work strengthened Multizer's SI capability: understanding both the electrical and the IT side makes it possible to carry a project from drawings to a working system.

Specialized capabilities: AI automation development (custom, tailored to each business), custom software development, helpdesk and troubleshooting, cybersecurity and network protection, cloud solutions, IT consulting and planning, network and cabling, CCTV and security, access control.

## How the work was done

1. Assess: review current systems, workflows, and pain points.
2. Plan: design a solution and timeline that fits the budget.
3. Deploy: install, configure, and test with minimal disruption.
4. Support: stay on as the ongoing IT department, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting.

## Who it served

Small businesses without an in-house IT department, plus residential customers needing computer, Wi-Fi, camera, or doorbell help.
